ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) central area to high-intensity (white) distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized contiguous low-intensity black region extending from the peduncle junction into the medial lobes. Distal regions transition to high-intensity white with dense black mottling on the left lobe and elongated black striations/speckling on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50-55 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude ragged serrations across the entire visible trailing edge, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys isolated against the water-spray background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted from the median notch extending symmetrically toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized on the extreme left and right distal tips. Dispersed white circular punctate marks on the central black region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, near-parallel vertical white linear disruptions on the right inner lobe surface, breaking the solid black pigment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization/encrustation on the distal margins of both fluke lobes; ragged trailing edge suggesting cumulative environmental wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jaggedness and irregularity of the trailing edge topography compared to smooth-edged variants.
